svg.title: TLS: a 5-byte record header, then the record
svg.desc: The TLS record of frame 1 of tls12-dsb.pcapng, 32 bits per row: the 5-byte record header, content type 22, handshake, the version 3.1 and the length 224, then the first bytes of the record, a handshake of type 1, Client Hello, of 220 bytes, which offers the version 3.3 and starts its random; TlsPacket keeps the content type, the version and the length of the header and borrows the 224 bytes of the record, which the crate does not decode.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
